sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: A couple years back, 99PI producer Emmett Fitzgerald created a series called Not Built for This.
sentences.zh: 几年前，99PI 制作人埃米特·菲茨杰拉德创作了一个名为《不适于此》的系列。

sentences.en: It was all about how the world we currently live in was not designed for the weather it's starting to experience.
sentences.zh: 这个系列讲述了我们目前生活的世界是如何无法应对它开始经历的极端天气的。

sentences.en: Emmett is back this week with an episode that has a lot in common with that series.
sentences.zh: 埃米特本周带着一集与该系列有很多共同点的新节目回归了。

sentences.en: And it takes place very close to 99PI headquarters in Berkeley, California.
sentences.zh: 而且故事就发生在距离加利福尼亚州伯克利 99PI 总部非常近的地方。

sentences.en: I'll let Emmett take it from here.
sentences.zh: 接下来我就把时间交给埃米特。

sentences.en: Michel Thuati had been dreaming of California since childhood.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·蒂瓦蒂从小就对加利福尼亚充满了梦想。

sentences.en: As a little French kid, he was obsessed with cowboys and big mountains and the American WeSt.
sentences.zh: 作为一个法国小男孩，他迷恋着牛仔、大山和美国西部。

sentences.en: And so when he finally arrived in Berkeley in 1984, he was totally prepared to fall in love with the place.
sentences.zh: 所以当他在 1984 年终于到达伯克利时，他已经完全做好准备爱上这个地方了。

sentences.en: But still, there was one thing in particular that exceeded his high expectations.
sentences.zh: 不过，仍然有一件特定事情超出了他原本很高的期望。

sentences.en: I remember being absolutely awed by that phenomenal richness of plants.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己当时被植物那惊人的丰富度完全震撼到了。

sentences.en: Almost anything can be grown around here, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这里几乎能种植任何东西。

sentences.en: So the variety, the colors, the textures were extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 所以品种、色彩和质感都非同寻常。

sentences.en: It was almost like being in a fairy tale, you know, for me.
sentences.zh: 对当时的盲目我来说，感觉就像是在童话里一样。
米歇尔是一个军人家庭的孩子。

sentences.en: He grew up bouncing around French naval bases, many of them in North Africa.
sentences.zh: 他在各个法国海军基地辗转长大，其中许多位于北非。

sentences.en: These were hot, dusty places without much in the way of vegetation.
sentences.zh: 那些都是炎热、尘土飞扬且没什么绿植的地方。

sentences.en: And looking at Berkeley was such a change.
sentences.zh: 因此看到伯克利时，感觉变化太大了。
这里的景观实在是太郁郁葱葱了。

sentences.en: Michel had come to California for a graduate program at UC Berkeley.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔是来加州大学伯克利分校攻读研究生项目的。

sentences.en: And his advisor had a beautiful house up in the Berkeley Hills with an incredible view of the Golden Gate.
sentences.zh: 他的导师在伯克利山有一栋美丽的房子，可以欣赏到金门大桥令人难以置信的景色。

sentences.en: And every time that Michel went over for dinner, he would look at the sun setting behind the bridge and think,
sentences.zh: 每次米歇尔过去吃晚饭时，他都会看着太阳在大桥背后落下，然后心想：

sentences.en: Someday, I want this view for myself.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，我也要拥有这样的风景。

sentences.en: I didn't really think I would ever be able to have it.
sentences.zh: 我其实并不觉得自己以后能拥有它。

sentences.en: The Berkeley Hills are an expensive place to live.
sentences.zh: 伯克利山是一个居住成本很高的地方。

sentences.en: But after grad school, Michel and his wife managed to find a fixer-upper that they could afford.
sentences.zh: 但在研究生毕业后，米歇尔和他的妻子设法找到了一处他们买得起、需要修缮的房子。

sentences.en: And we essentially spent the next 10 years investing every minute that we had and every dollar into turning the house into a place that we liked living in.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的十年里，我们基本上把所有的时间和每一分钱都投入到把这栋房子变成我们喜欢居住的地方上。

sentences.en: The most important home improvement project for Michel was the yard.
sentences.zh: 对米歇尔来说，最重要的家居改造项目就是院子。

sentences.en: He planted a lush, unruly garden, just like the ones he fell in love with when he first got to Berkeley.
sentences.zh: 他种下了一座郁郁葱葱、不拘一格的花园，就像他刚到伯克利时一见钟情的那样。

sentences.en: There were dense blocks of shrubs right against the sides of the house.
sentences.zh: 房子紧挨着的两边长满了密集的灌木丛。

sentences.en: Persimmon trees and figs, jasmine vines crawling up the walls.
sentences.zh: 柿子树和无花果树，还有顺着墙壁攀爬的茉莉藤。

sentences.en: All was well in the garden.
sentences.zh: 花园里的一切都安然无恙。

sentences.en: At least for a little while.
sentences.zh: 至少在短暂的一段时间里是这样。

sentences.en: A fresh look at the damage from the CZU lightning complex fire raging in Santa Cruz County.
sentences.zh: 全新视角审视圣克鲁斯县狂虐的CZU雷暴综合森林大火造成的破坏。

sentences.en: Between 2015 and 2020, California experienced 10 of the most destructive wildfires in its history.
sentences.zh: 2015年至2020年间，加利福尼亚州经历了其历史上最具破坏性的10场野火。

sentences.en: One of the biggest fires is threatening the city of Calistoga.
sentences.zh: 其中一场最大的火灾正威胁着卡利斯托加市。

sentences.en: And as fire risk grew more and more omnipresent in the psychology of Californians,
sentences.zh: 随着火灾风险在加州人的心理中越来越无处不在，

sentences.en: Michel's wife started to get nervous about their verdant hilltop dream home.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的妻子开始对他们那栋郁郁葱葱的山顶梦想家园感到不安。

sentences.en: My wife realized the problems about wildfire much earlier than I did.
sentences.zh: 我妻子意识到野火问题的时间比我早得多。

sentences.en: So I was in total denial early on.
sentences.zh: 所以一开始我完全处于否认状态。

sentences.en: At one point, Michel's wife even suggested that they consider moving out of the hills
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，米歇尔的妻子甚至建议他们考虑搬出山丘，

sentences.en: and down into the flatter parts of Berkeley that were less vulnerable to fire.
sentences.zh: 搬到伯克利地势较平坦、受火灾威胁较小的地区。

sentences.en: But Michel was having none of it.
sentences.zh: 但米歇尔根本听不进去。

sentences.en: Then I said, look, I'm going to research this and I'm going to prove it to you that you're wrong
sentences.zh: 然后我说，听着，我要研究这个问题，我要向你证明你是错的，

sentences.en: And we know how it turned out because we weren't safe at all.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道结果如何，因为我们一点也不安全。

sentences.en: It turned out that Michel's neighborhood was actually extremely vulnerable to wildfire.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，米歇尔的社区实际上极其容易遭受野火袭击。

sentences.en: And part of the reason why was precisely because of all those lush gardens that had attracted him to the area in the first place.
sentences.zh: 部分原因恰恰是因为当初吸引他来到这里的那些郁郁葱葱的花园。

sentences.en: And as he did more research, Michel began wading into a contentious debate that is playing out all across California
sentences.zh: 随着他深入研究，米歇尔开始卷入一场在整个加州展开的激烈争论，

sentences.en: about how to adapt our homes and communities for an era of increasingly extreme wildfire risk.
sentences.zh: 讨论如何在日益极端的野火风险时代调整我们的房屋和社区。

sentences.en: In Berkeley, it would eventually bubble over.
sentences.zh: 在伯克利，这种矛盾最终彻底爆发了。

sentences.en: There would be recall campaigns and accusations flying around online.
sentences.zh: 将会出现罢免运动，网络上也会充斥着各种指责。

sentences.en: But to understand how it all got so tense, it helps to know a bit more about the area.
sentences.zh: 但要理解为什么局势会变得如此紧张，我们需要对该地区有更多的了解。

sentences.en: Because it's not just that these gardens are central to the character of the Berkeley Hills.
sentences.zh: 因为这不仅是因为这些花园是伯克利山特色核心所在。

sentences.en: It's that they're part of a very specific architectural history that has roots going back more than 100 years.
sentences.zh: 还因为它们属于一种非常特殊的建筑历史，其根源可追溯到100多年前。

sentences.en: Berkeley, California is synonymous with 1960s counterculture.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州伯克利是20世纪60年代反文化运动的代名词。

sentences.en: But the city's bohemianism actually began long before the free speech movement and the Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 但这座城市的波希米亚主义实际上远早于言论自由运动和越南战争。

sentences.en: All the way back in the 1890s, Berkeley was a hotbed for artists and poets and intellectuals.
sentences.zh: 早在19世纪90年代，伯克利就是艺术家、诗人和知识分子的温床。

sentences.en: Around the turn of the 20th century, a number of these free thinkers began moving up into the hills above the University of California, Berkeley,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪之交左右，许多这些自由思想家开始搬到加州大学伯克利分校上方的山丘上，

sentences.en: which at the time were grasslands speckled with oak trees.
sentences.zh: 当时那里是点缀着橡树的草原。

sentences.en: And as more and more people started to build houses up there, they formed a social organization that tried to shape what the development would look like.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的人开始在那里建造房屋，他们成立了一个社会组织，试图塑造开发建设的外观。

sentences.en: It was called the Berkeley Hillside Club.
sentences.zh: 它被称为伯克利山地俱乐部。

sentences.en: The Berkeley Hillside Club was founded in 1898 by a group of Berkeley women who fundamentally were interested in preventing the Berkeley hillsides from being disfigured.
sentences.zh: 伯克利山地俱乐部由一群伯克利女性于1898年创立，她们本质上致力于防止伯克利山坡遭到破坏。

sentences.en: This is David Mostardi, who is the historian of the Hillside Club, which is still active to this day.
sentences.zh: 这是戴维·莫斯塔尔迪，他是山地俱乐部的历史学家，该俱乐部至今仍然活跃。

sentences.en: And David says that the club's definition of disfigurement was basically what had happened just across the bridge in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 戴维说，俱乐部对“破坏”的定义基本上就是海湾对岸旧金山发生的事情。

sentences.en: When San Francisco's famous hills were developed for the first time,
sentences.zh: 当旧金山著名的山丘首次被开发时，

sentences.en: they just laid a perfectly rectangular street grid down on the landscape
sentences.zh: 他们只是在景观上铺设了一个完全矩形的街道网格，

sentences.en: and built Victorian gingerbread houses up and down the steep slopes.
sentences.zh: 并在陡峭的山坡上建造了维多利亚式的姜饼小屋。

sentences.en: And the women at the Hillside Club felt that this was a desecration of what California had to offer.
sentences.zh: 山地俱乐部的女性们认为这是对加州所拥有自然风貌的亵渎。

sentences.en: The members of the Hillside Club wanted a different kind of architecture for the Berkeley Hills,
sentences.zh: 山地俱乐部的成员希望为伯克利山寻找一种不同风格的建筑，

sentences.en: one that was more attuned to the area's unique landscape.
sentences.zh: 一个更加契合该地区独特地貌的方案。

sentences.en: And they found the perfect architect to realize that vision in an eccentric New Yorker named Bernard Maybeck.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了实现这一愿景的完美建筑师，一位名叫伯纳德·梅贝克的古怪纽约人。

sentences.en: You know, Maybeck was a bohemian sort of fellow.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，梅贝克是个颇具波西米亚风格的人。

sentences.en: Gray Breckin, the historian, calls Maybeck the first hippie,
sentences.zh: 历史学家格雷·布雷金称梅贝克为第一代嬉皮士，

sentences.en: you know, 80 years before the other hippies came to town.
sentences.zh: 比其他嬉皮士来到这个城市早了八十年。

sentences.en: Maybeck trained at the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris before arriving in the Bay Area with his wife Annie in 1890.
sentences.zh: 梅贝克曾在巴黎美术学院接受培训，并于1890年携妻子安妮来到湾区。

sentences.en: And Maybeck was a genuine oddball.
sentences.zh: 而且梅贝克是个货真价实的怪胎。

sentences.en: He had a long, dwarven beard and often dressed in red robes he sewed himself.
sentences.zh: 他留着长长的侏儒般的胡须，经常穿着自己缝制的红色长袍。

sentences.en: When his first child was born, Maybeck called the baby boy
sentences.zh: 当他的第一个孩子出生时，梅贝克叫这个小男孩

sentences.en: until the age the kid was old enough to choose a name for himself.
sentences.zh: 直到这孩子长到能够自己给自己取名字的年龄。

sentences.en: And Maybeck's diet was like that of a teenage art school student.
sentences.zh: 而且梅贝克的饮食就像一个十几岁的艺术院校学生。

sentences.en: Somebody in a recent article said he was a vegetarian.
sentences.zh: 最近有一篇文章说他是素食主义者。

sentences.en: He lived on fried potatoes, coffee, and donuts.
sentences.zh: 他靠炸土豆、咖啡和甜甜圈度日。

sentences.en: This is Maybeck's daughter-in-law, Giacomina, in an interview with the Berkeley Historical Society.
sentences.zh: 这是梅贝克的儿媳贾科米娜在接受伯克利历史学会采访时的谈话。

sentences.en: Giacomina also lived in the Berkeley Hills,
sentences.zh: 贾科米娜也住在伯克利山，

sentences.en: and she frequently stopped by for coffee with the red-robed potato eater.
sentences.zh: 她经常顺道去和那个穿着红袍、吃土豆的人喝咖啡。

sentences.en: I could not keep up with him, and I could not interpret everything he said.
sentences.zh: 我跟不上他的节奏，也无法理解他所说的一切。

sentences.en: He was a great reader, and he threw it all in together like a big soup.
sentences.zh: 他博览群书，却把所有东西像熬一大锅汤似的全都揉合在了一起。
梅贝克是个文艺复兴式的全才。

sentences.en: In one of the only remaining recorded interviews with him,
sentences.zh: 在他仅存的几段采访录音之一中，

sentences.en: he implores architects to seek inspiration outside the confines of their profession.
sentences.zh: 他恳求建筑师们在他们职业局限之外去寻找灵感。

sentences.en: From history, from different countries, and literature, and the theater,
sentences.zh: 从历史、从不同的国家、从文学和戏剧中，

sentences.en: all those ideals you are to absorb.
sentences.zh: 所有这些理念你们都应该去吸收。

sentences.en: Maybeck considered architecture to be as much an art form as a practical trade,
sentences.zh: 梅贝克认为建筑既是一门艺术形式，也是一门实用的手艺，

sentences.en: and he thought that buildings should, above all else, be beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他认为建筑最重要的是应该美丽。

sentences.en: Beauty is the essence of architecture.
In other words, it isn't a question of the man living in the building,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这不仅仅是住在房子里的人的问题，

sentences.en: or whether he has a refrigerator and all that sort of thing,
sentences.zh: 或者他是否有冰箱以及诸如此类的东西，

sentences.en: but it's the man in the street who has to look at your building when it's done.
sentences.zh: 而是当你的建筑完工时，走在街上的人必须看着它。

sentences.en: Bernard Maybeck designed many beautiful buildings in a wide variety of styles,
sentences.zh: 伯纳德·梅贝克设计了许多风格各异的精美建筑，

sentences.en: but his most enduring legacy might be the arts and crafts houses that he built in the Berkeley Hills.
sentences.zh: 但他最持久的遗产可能是他在伯克利山建造的工艺美术运动风格的住宅。

sentences.en: The idea of the arts and crafts movement was to simplify architecture back to its basics,
sentences.zh: 工艺美术运动的理念是将建筑简化回其基本要素，

sentences.en: to move away from the excess of the Industrial Revolution and Victorian-era frippery,
sentences.zh: 摆脱工业革命的过剩和维多利亚时代的繁琐装饰，

sentences.en: and to build simple, beautiful structures that were in tune with the natural world around them.
sentences.zh: 建造出与周围自然世界和谐相处的简单而美丽的结构。

sentences.en: Maybeck's first commission in Berkeley was for a writer named Charles Keillor.
sentences.zh: 梅贝克在伯克利接到的第一个委托是为一位名叫查尔斯·基勒的作家设计的。

sentences.en: And the house that he built, Keillor was like a wooden temple.
sentences.zh: 而他建造的那座房子，基勒的房子就像一座木结构的神庙。

sentences.en: It had a steep, vaulted ceiling with chunky, exposed redwood beaMs.
sentences.zh: 它有着陡峭的拱形天花板，配有厚重外露的红木横梁。

sentences.en: And in what would become a signature of Berkeley architecture,
sentences.zh: 而在后来成为伯克利建筑特色的一点上，

sentences.en: the exterior of the house, including the roof, was clad entirely in wooden shingles.
sentences.zh: 房子的外观，包括屋顶，完全覆满了木瓦。

sentences.en: Keillor, for his part, adored the house,
sentences.zh: 凯洛尔本人非常喜爱这栋房子，

sentences.en: and he bragged about it to anyone who would listen.
sentences.zh: 并且向任何愿意听的人吹嘘它。

sentences.en: In fact, he became something of a propagandist for Maybeck's arts and crafts vision.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他几乎成了梅贝克工艺美术愿景的宣传者。

sentences.en: One of his most influential pieces, if not the most influential piece he ever wrote,
sentences.zh: 他所写过最具影响力的一部作品（如果不是最具有影响力的的话），

sentences.en: was a book called The Simple Home.
sentences.zh: 是一本名为《简朴的家》的书。

sentences.en: Keillor published The Simple Home in 1904.
sentences.zh: 凯洛尔于1904年出版了《简朴的家》。

sentences.en: And around the same time, he was elected president of the Berkeley Hillside Club.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，他被选为伯克利山地俱乐部的会长。

sentences.en: And it became a manifesto of sorts for the Hillside Club.
sentences.zh: 这本书也成了山地俱乐部的一份某种意义上的宣言。

sentences.en: So basically, here's how you go about building a house in the Berkeley Hills.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这就是你在伯克利山建造房屋的方式。

sentences.en: Bernard Maybeck was also a member of the Hillside Club by this point.
sentences.zh: 伯纳德·梅贝克到此时也成为了山地俱乐部的成员。

sentences.en: And he and Keillor helped shape the organization's philosophy about architecture and also landscape.
sentences.zh: 他和凯洛尔共同塑造了该组织关于建筑以及景观的哲学。

sentences.en: One of the primary tenets of this philosophy was that all new development in the hills
sentences.zh: 这种哲学的主要信条之一是，山区的所有新开发项目

sentences.en: should respect the area's unique geology.
sentences.zh: 都应尊重该地区独特的地理地貌。

sentences.en: Instead of the symmetrical grid that had been laid down on San Francisco's hills,
sentences.zh: 与旧金山山丘上铺设的对称网格不同，

sentences.en: roads in Berkeley should be carved into the contours of the hillside.
sentences.zh: 伯克利的道路应该根据山坡的等高线来开辟。

sentences.en: If there was a rock in the way...
You don't blow the rock up into smithereens and go straight through.
sentences.zh: 你不能把岩石炸得粉碎然后直直穿过去。

sentences.en: If there's a huge old oak tree in the way, you go around the tree.
sentences.zh: 如果路中间有一棵巨大的老橡树，你就绕过这棵树。

sentences.en: You're integrating all of these things into the architecture and the landscape.
sentences.zh: 你要将所有这些元素融入到建筑和景观中。

sentences.en: The club had very specific recommendations for anyone who wanted to buy a house on the hill.
sentences.zh: 对于任何想在山上买房的人，俱乐部都有非常具体的建议。

sentences.en: David pulled out a pamphlet from this era that the Hillside Club gave to prospective homebuyers.
sentences.zh: 大卫拿出了这个时代山地俱乐部发给潜在购房者的一份小册子。

sentences.en: This is the landscape architecture pamphlet from 1906.
sentences.zh: 这是1906年的景观建筑小册子。
这是一件精美的作品，是的。

sentences.en: Flipping through, I was surprised by just how much of the text was devoted to gardening.
sentences.zh: 翻阅时，我惊讶于如此多的文字竟然都在讲述园艺。

sentences.en: To the Hillside Club, the garden was the most important feature of any property.
sentences.zh: 对山地俱乐部来说，花园是任何房产最重要的特色。

sentences.en: More important even than the house, which the pamphlet jokes was really only necessary as protection from inclement weather.
sentences.zh: 甚至比房子还重要，小册子开玩笑说，房子其实只是为了防范恶劣天气才需要的。

sentences.en: Hillside architecture is landscape gardening around a few rooms for use in case of rain.
sentences.zh: 山地建筑就是围绕着几个用于雨天防雨的房间进行的景观园艺。

sentences.en: The idea was to have a complete continuity between the house and the garden.
sentences.zh: 这个理念是要让房屋和花园之间保持完全的连贯性。

sentences.en: A seamless transition between indoors and outdoors.
sentences.zh: 室内与室外之间无缝的过渡。

sentences.en: The club called for extensive planting of trees and shrubs right up to the edge of the house.
sentences.zh: 俱乐部号召在紧邻房屋边缘的地方大量种植树木和灌木。

sentences.en: They wanted figs and plums with trailing willows and ivy-covered walls.
sentences.zh: 他们想要无花果树、李子树，配上垂柳和爬满常春藤的墙壁。

sentences.en: The pamphlet was an invitation to partner with the Hillside Club and help turn the Berkeley Hills into a lush California Arcadia.
sentences.zh: 这本小册子是一份邀请函，邀请人们与山地俱乐部合作，将伯克利山变成一片郁郁葱葱的加州世外桃源。

sentences.en: With the help of the hillbier, the Hillside Club can lay out on the Berkeley Hills a perfect landscape, connecting green canyons with piling green forests,
sentences.zh: 在山地建设者的帮助下，山边俱乐部得以在伯克利山规划出完美的景观，将青翠的峡谷与层叠的郁郁葱葱的森林连为一体，

sentences.en: making of the barren place as a park, with only here and there a tower or a glimpse of roof to tell of the city underneath.
sentences.zh: 把这片贫瘠的土地变成了一座公园，只有零星的塔楼或隐约的屋顶提示着下方还有一座城市。

sentences.en: A city of homes in an immense garden.
sentences.zh: 一座坐落在巨大花园中的住宅之城。

sentences.en: The only problem with the Hillside Club's beautiful dream of a garden city was that the Berkeley Hills are a landscape that is meant to burn.
sentences.zh: 山边俱乐部的这座美丽的花园城市之梦，唯一的问题在于伯克利山的景观本就是注定要燃烧的。

sentences.en: And the earthy design principles that shaped the development of the hills were pretty much a nightmare from the perspective of wildfire risk.
sentences.zh: 从野火风险的角度来看，塑造该山地开发项目的那些崇尚自然的规划原则简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: The wood-shingled houses were highly flammable, the twisted streets were hard to evacuate, and the dense, lush gardens grown right next to the house were the perfect fire fuel.
sentences.zh: 木瓦屋顶的房屋极易燃烧，错综复杂的街道难以疏散，而紧挨着房屋生长的茂密葱郁的花园则是绝佳的火灾燃料。

sentences.en: Maybeck and company had unintentionally built a lush, idyllic fire trap.
sentences.zh: 梅贝克及其同伴无意中建造了一个郁郁葱葱、田园诗般的火药桶。
而在1923年，不可避免的事情发生了。

sentences.en: It all happened on one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在同一个下午。

sentences.en: In fact, the Hillside Club was going to have its annual dinner that night.
sentences.zh: 事实上，山腰俱乐部当晚本要举行年度晚宴。

sentences.en: A fire started in the afternoon up the hill, and within six hours it had burned all the way down to the flat parts of Berkeley.
sentences.zh: 下午山丘上燃起了一场大火，在六小时内一直烧到了伯克利的平坦地区。

sentences.en: The fire destroyed many of the houses that Maybeck designed, including his own.
sentences.zh: 大火烧毁了梅贝克设计的许多房屋，包括他自己的房子。

sentences.en: And the Hillside Club's clubhouse, which he also designed, burned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 而他设计的山腰俱乐部会所也被烧为平地。

sentences.en: In the following decades, the hills were rebuilt, and there were gestures towards fire safety.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，山坡完成了重建，并采取了一些防火安全措施。

sentences.en: Many of the homes were remade with stucco rather than wood.
sentences.zh: 许多房屋改用灰泥而非木材重建。

sentences.en: And Maybeck himself started experimenting with fire-safe materials.
sentences.zh: 梅贝克本人也开始试验防火材料。

sentences.en: But much of the Hillside Club's arts and crafts vision, and particularly the dense and beautiful gardens, remain intact to this day.
sentences.zh: 但山坡俱乐部的许多工艺美术理念，尤其是那些密布而美丽的庭院，至今仍完好无损。

sentences.en: When Michel Thuati first got to Berkeley in the 80s, it was this vision that he fell in love with.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，当米歇尔·蒂亚蒂初到伯克利时，正是这种理念让他深深倾心。

sentences.en: And over the years, he grew a garden that Bernhard Maybeck would be proud of.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他培育了一座让伯纳德·梅贝克也会引以为豪的花园。

sentences.en: It even had a few rooms in case of rain.
sentences.zh: 甚至还准备了几个房间以防下雨。

sentences.en: But by 2020, he was becoming increasingly worried about fire risk.
sentences.zh: 但到了2020年，他开始越来越担心火灾风险。

sentences.en: By this point, insurance rates in the hills were starting to skyrocket, and anxiety about fire was widespread.
sentences.zh: 此时，山区的保险费率开始急剧飙升，对火灾的焦虑情绪十分普遍。

sentences.en: And so, Michel did what he does beSt.
sentences.zh: 于是，米歇尔做了他最擅长的事。

sentences.en: I have a little bit of OCD sometimes.
And so, I read, for a year and a half, I read every single paper on what I discovered was called wildfire science.
sentences.zh: 因此，我阅读了——在一年半的时间里，我阅读了每一篇关于我所发现的所谓的野火科学的论文。

sentences.en: Probably four, five, six hundred articles.
sentences.zh: 大概有四百、五百、六百篇文章吧。

sentences.en: I got in touch with some of the most prominent wildfire scientists in the country.
sentences.zh: 我联系了国内一些最著名的野火科学家。

sentences.en: And they all told him the same thing, that his home was in a high fire risk area,
sentences.zh: 他们都告诉他同样的事情，那就是他的家位于高火灾风险区，

sentences.en: and that the garden that he had grown right against the side of the house was only exacerbating that risk.
sentences.zh: 而且他紧挨着房子种的花园只会加剧这种风险。

sentences.en: It took me basically 2020 to 2022 to move to a psychological point when I was ready to actually do things.
sentences.zh: 我基本上花了2020年到2022年的时间，才在心理上做好了真正采取行动的准备。

sentences.en: So, in 2022, I realized that we had to change, and I started slowly making changes.
sentences.zh: 所以，在2022年，我意识到我们必须改变，于是我开始慢慢做出改变。

sentences.en: Michel learned that the most effective steps he could take to mitigate that risk would be to harden his home to wildfire and create what's called defensible space.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔了解到，为了降低这种风险，他能采取的最有效的措施就是让他的住宅具备抵御野火的能力，并创建所谓的防御空间。

sentences.en: Defensible space is a concept that was developed by a wildfire scientist named Jack Cohen.
sentences.zh: 防御空间是由一位名叫杰克·科恩的野火科学家提出的概念。

sentences.en: We actually did a whole episode about him that you can find back in the archives.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上做过一整期关于他的节目，你可以在过往的档案里找到。

sentences.en: But the idea at its simplest was that if you get rid of all the flammable stuff around a house,
sentences.zh: 但这个想法最简单的一点是，如果你清理掉房屋周围所有易燃物品，

sentences.en: you make it much less likely for the house itself to catch on fire.
sentences.zh: 房屋本身着火的可能性就会大大降低。

sentences.en: Contrary to what many people imagine, in most cases, wildfires do not consume houses in a tidal wave of flame.
sentences.zh: 与许多人的想象相反，在大多数情况下，野火并不是以滔天火海吞噬房屋的。

sentences.en: It's much more likely that a house catches on fire because of a single ember.
sentences.zh: 房屋起火更有可能是因为一枚小小的火星。

sentences.en: As a fire burns, it launches a blizzard of embers into the air.
sentences.zh: 当森林大火燃烧时，它会向空中喷射出一阵暴风雪般的火星。

sentences.en: They drift along on the wind, and if one lands on the dead leaves in your gutter,
sentences.zh: 它们随风飘荡，如果有一颗落在了你排水沟里的枯叶上，

sentences.en: or the weeds growing in your alley, or the dry grass landscaping out front,
sentences.zh: 或是你弄堂里生长的杂草上，又或是前院干枯的景观草坪上，

sentences.en: it can easily burn down your entire house.
sentences.zh: 它就很轻易能烧毁你的整栋房子。

sentences.en: But if you get rid of all that flammable stuff, then the ember threat goes way down.
sentences.zh: 但如果你清理掉所有这些易燃物，火星的威胁就会大幅下降。

sentences.en: For Michel, this was going to be very difficult because he had a lot of plants growing around his house.
sentences.zh: 对米歇尔来说，这会非常困难，因为他的房子周围种了许多植物。

sentences.en: Well, you really couldn't see the bottom 10 feet of the wall pretty much anywhere
sentences.zh: 事实上，几乎在任何地方，你都看不到墙壁底部大约三米高的部分，

sentences.en: because it was absolutely covered with shrubs.
sentences.zh: 因为那里完全被灌木丛覆盖了。
但米歇尔开始砍伐清理。

sentences.en: He cut down a lot of plants and transplanted others further away from the structure.
sentences.zh: 他砍掉了许多植物，并将其他的移植到离建筑更远的地方。

sentences.en: It was hard work physically and emotionally.
sentences.zh: 这在体力和情感上都是一项艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: He had spent a lot of time and effort growing that garden,
sentences.zh: 他花了很多时间和精力来培育那个花园，

sentences.en: and he had deep feelings about many of the plants.
sentences.zh: 并且他对其中的许多植物有着深厚的感情。

sentences.en: I can smell a fig tree sometimes from 200 or 300 yards away.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我在两三百码外就能闻到无花果树的气味。

sentences.en: And walking in my garden, every time I would smell the fig tree,
sentences.zh: 在花园里散步时，每次闻到无花果树的味道，

sentences.en: and ugh, cutting it was very difficult.
sentences.zh: 唉，砍掉它真的非常艰难。

sentences.en: As painful as it was, Michel was committed.
sentences.zh: 尽管过程痛苦，但米歇尔态度坚定。

sentences.en: And little by little, he re-landscaped the entire property with defensible space in mind.
sentences.zh: 他一点一点地重新规划了整个物业的景观，把防火空间考虑了进去。

sentences.en: But the thing about defensible space is that it really only works if everyone around you does it too.
sentences.zh: 但防火空间的问题在于，它通常只有在周围所有人也都这样做时才真正有效。

sentences.en: Wildfire experts love to say that what most determines whether your house will burn down in a fire
sentences.zh: 野火专家们总喜欢说，决定你家是否会在火灾中被烧毁的关键因素

sentences.en: is whether your neighbor's house burns down.
sentences.zh: 是你邻居的房子是否被烧毁。

sentences.en: And so Michel started organizing with his neighbors.
sentences.zh: 因此，米歇尔开始组织邻居们行动起来。

sentences.en: They created a series of firewise groups and began working together to try to make the entire neighborhood safer.
sentences.zh: 他们成立了一系列防火意识小组，开始合作，试图让整个社区变得更安全。

sentences.en: Still, they didn't have any real political power to mandate changes.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们并没有真正的政治权力来强制推行变革。

sentences.en: And so while they made some progress on defensible space with some houses,
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然他们在一些房子的防火空间上取得了一些进展，

sentences.en: many other gardens remained overgrown and dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但许多其他花园仍然杂草丛生、充满隐患。

sentences.en: Around this time, a new city councilor was elected to represent the Berkeley Hills.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，伯克利山选出了一位新的市议员。
他的名字叫布伦特·布莱卡比。

sentences.en: And on the surface, he didn't seem like a transformational political figure.
sentences.zh: 表面上看，他似乎并不是一个能带来变革的政治人物。

sentences.en: On the campaign, he talked about the issues that every California politician seems to talk about.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，他谈论的都是每个加州政客似乎都在谈论的问题。

sentences.en: Building more housing, dealing with homelessness.
sentences.zh: 建设更多住房，解决无家可归问题。

sentences.en: Blackaby knew that wildfire was an issue in the hills.
sentences.zh: 布莱卡比深知山火是当地山丘地区的一个问题。

sentences.en: But just a few weeks into the job, the stakes were made very clear
sentences.zh: 但就在上任短短几周后，情况变得异常严峻

sentences.en: when the city of Los Angeles experienced the most destructive fire in its history.
sentences.zh: 当时洛杉矶市经历了其历史上最具破坏性的火灾。

sentences.en: This morning, the firestorm officials had feared becoming a reality.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨，官员们一直恐惧的火灾风暴变成了现实。

sentences.en: In the coastal neighborhood Pacific Palisades, multiple homes completely engulfed in flames,
sentences.zh: 在沿海社区太平洋帕利塞兹，多栋房屋完全被大火吞没，

sentences.en: with desperate residents rushing to get out.
sentences.zh: 绝望的居民们争相逃生。

sentences.en: The parallels between the Berkeley Hills and the Palisades were obvious to Blackaby.
sentences.zh: 伯克利山和帕利塞兹之间的相似之处对布莱卡比来说显而易见。

sentences.en: They're both coastal hillside communities with perilous fall winds.
sentences.zh: 它们都是伴随着危险秋风的沿海山坡社区。

sentences.en: And as he watched the Palisades burn on the news, Blackaby felt a growing sense of terror.
sentences.zh: 当布莱卡比在新闻中看着帕利塞兹燃烧时，他感到一种越来越强的恐惧感。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it was scary.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，这太可怕了。

sentences.en: I think you always kind of knew from an academic perspective, intellectual perspective,
sentences.zh: 我想你从学术角度、理性角度总归会有所了解，

sentences.en: Driving through the neighborhood, walking around with my kids,
sentences.zh: 开车穿过社区，和我的孩子们一起散步，

sentences.en: I just, I couldn't live with myself if we just sort of said,
sentences.zh: 我只是，如果我们就这样说，

sentences.en: hey, well, we're going to hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，好吧，我们只能祈祷一切顺利，那我将无法原谅自己。

sentences.en: At this point, the state of California was considering updates to state-level defensible space rules.
sentences.zh: 此时，加利福尼亚州正在考虑更新州级可防御空间规则。

sentences.en: But it was taking a long time.
And Blackaby was anxious to get moving.
sentences.zh: 而布莱卡比急于采取行动。

sentences.en: He got together with a small group of politicians and members of the fire department
sentences.zh: 他与一小群政治家和消防部门成员聚在一起，

sentences.en: to talk about how to respond.
And kind of the consensus in our little small group was like,
sentences.zh: 我们这个小团体基本达成了一种共识，那就是，

sentences.en: This is a wake-up call for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说是一个警钟。

sentences.en: We just can't afford to wait any longer.
And if we're always going to wait for someone else to do it,
sentences.zh: 如果我们总是指望别人来做这件事，

sentences.en: we're never going to do it.
And so shortly after getting into office,
Blackaby introduced a bold new wildfire adaptation plan for the Berkeley Hills,
sentences.zh: 布莱卡比为伯克利山推出了一项大胆的野火适应新计划，

sentences.en: an initiative called the Ember Ordinance.
sentences.zh: 这项倡议被称为“余烬条例”。

sentences.en: And there's a number of things to it, but the big one is Zone Zero,
sentences.zh: 它包含许多内容，但最重要的一点是“零号区”，

sentences.en: or the home ignition zone, which is the space within five feet of a structure.
sentences.zh: 也就是房屋引火区，即建筑物周围五英尺以内的空间。

sentences.en: And that area has to be free of any combustible material of any kind.
sentences.zh: 该区域必须没有任何形式的可燃材料。

sentences.en: He's a retired wildland firefighter and a fire risk expert
sentences.zh: 他是一名退休的野火消防员兼火灾风险专家，

sentences.en: who was brought in to help with the rollout of the Ember Ordinance.
sentences.zh: 被请来协助推行“余烬条例”。

sentences.en: And Dave says that Ember makes an exception for mature trees,
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，余烬条例对成熟树木网开一面，

sentences.en: but otherwise, you can have nothing flammable in Zone Zero at all.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，零号区内绝对不能有任何易燃物。

sentences.en: No shrubs, no jute doormats, no wooden gates.
sentences.zh: 没有灌木丛，没有黄麻门垫，没有木制大门。

sentences.en: Nothing burnable within five feet of the structure.
sentences.zh: 建筑物周围五英尺内不得有任何可燃物。

sentences.en: In other words, basically the exact opposite of the vision laid out
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这基本上与一百多年前，

sentences.en: in that Hillside Club pamphlet over a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 那份山地俱乐部宣传册中所描绘的愿景完全相反。

sentences.en: Instead of a seamless transition between the house and the garden,
sentences.zh: 条例没有要求房屋与花园之间平稳过渡，

sentences.en: the ordinance essentially calls for a protective moat of lifelessness around every home.
sentences.zh: 而是实质上要求在每栋房屋周围建立一道毫无生气的保护性护城河。

sentences.en: Dave says that they knew this was going to be a hard sell.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，他们知道这很难推行。

sentences.en: And so since this is so hard,
and because the margin of failure is so thin at the individual parcel level
sentences.zh: 而且无论是从单个地块层面还是从社区层面来看，

sentences.en: it's critical that we focus on the absolute smallest possible distribution
sentences.zh: 所以至关重要的是，我们要专注于尽可能最小的工作分布，

sentences.en: of the least amount of work to be effective.
sentences.zh: 以最少的工作量达到最高效的结果。

sentences.en: The fire department carefully selected a zone of about 950 homes
sentences.zh: 消防部门精心挑选了大约 950 栋房屋所在的区域，

sentences.en: right along the edge of Tilden Park,
sentences.zh: 它们正好位于蒂尔登公园边缘，

sentences.en: where a fire was most likely to start.
This was a tactical choice to try and create a buffer between the city and the park.
sentences.zh: 这是一个战术选择，旨在城市和公园之间建立一个缓冲带。

sentences.en: That way, if a wildfire were to start in Tilden,
sentences.zh: 这样一来，如果蒂尔登公园爆发野火，

sentences.en: it would be much harder for the embers to catch houses on fire
and burn down the entire hillside.
sentences.zh: 从而避免整座山坡被烧毁。

sentences.en: the ordinance also calls on residents to do things like install gutter guards
sentences.zh: 该条例还要求居民采取诸如安装天沟防护网等措施，

sentences.en: and cover their vents with metal mesh
sentences.zh: 并用金属网罩住通风口，

sentences.en: to prevent embers from getting inside the house itself.
sentences.zh: 以防止火星进入房屋内部。

sentences.en: And if we can get everyone in those areas to do everything,
sentences.zh: 如果我们能让这些区域的每个人都做好所有这些工作，

sentences.en: we will have achieved a state of wildfire adaptation
sentences.zh: 我们将实现野火适应状态，

sentences.en: and we will form a non-burnable buffer by virtue of this program
sentences.zh: 并通过这个项目形成一个不可燃的缓冲带，

sentences.en: so that the other 10,000 homes that live downhill,
